revenue_base.method: Average revenue of the last 3 months, rolled forward to the last month at revenue_growth

revenue_growth.method: Log-linear trend fit over the last 12 months of revenue

gross_margin.method: (revenue - cogs) / revenue over the last 6 months

opex_base.method: Average opex of the last 3 months, rolled forward to the last month at opex_growth

opex_growth.method: Log-linear trend fit over the last 12 months of opex

other_net.method: Average net other income of the last 6 months

revenue.label: Driver model: trend growth x seasonal index
revenue.reason: Lowest backtest error over 3 origins x 6 months (WAPE 1.3%); simpler models win near-ties

opex.label: Driver model: trend growth x seasonal index
opex.reason: Lowest backtest error over 3 origins x 6 months (WAPE 1.9%); simpler models win near-ties

uncertainty.method: Each path multiplies the point forecast by noise fitted to history: a starting-level error, a growth-rate error that compounds, and month-to-month AR(1) noise. Gross margin and other income vary around their fitted values. Lines are simulated independently. Ranges are widened, never narrowed, when the backtest shows they caught fewer than 80% of actual months.
